g.text: I design in Figma and build web apps with React and Laravel.
I'm a full-stack developer and BS Information Systems student based in Dasmariñas, Cavite. I design
interfaces in Figma and build web apps with React, Laravel, and Supabase. My projects include a
school transparency platform, a local-first focus app, and a birthday-sharing app.
Role-based governance and a tamper-evident financial ledger for KLD.
Keyboard-first, local-first focus timer + tasks + notes. No account.
Birthday letters, wishes and gifts in one link. No signup.
A desktop-style portfolio with case studies and recruiter details.
A React and TypeScript code bundle based on a Figma design.
Certificate of Participation · IEEE CS Philippines
Building systems that can explain themselves.
